title: The Virtuosa arrives: Deonna Purrazzo vs. Jordynne Grace
summary: Deonna Purrazzo challenges Jordynne Grace’s power with targeted submission wrestling. Their championship rivalry establishes the Virtuosa through a title win and the Knockouts’ first thirty-minute Iron Woman match.

chapters.title: Purrazzo submits the champion
chapters.result: Deonna defeats Grace for the Knockouts title.
chapters.context: Attacking Grace’s arm turns Purrazzo’s technical identity into a championship-winning strategy. Grace demands another chance.

chapters.title: The Iron Woman rematch
chapters.result: Purrazzo defeats Grace two falls to one to retain.
chapters.context: Grace takes the first fall, but Deonna levels the score and forces a late submission. The television main event strengthens Purrazzo’s claim to control the division.
